items.title: Shelly Berg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: We did the Dennis Miller Millennium Special which was a blast.

ctx.x: What’s on the docket for you in the very near future? Writing assignments?

Yeah, I’m doing some writing. I just wrapped up a couple of cool television projects. We did the Dennis Miller Millennium Special which was a blast. I did a Korean movie. So © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-

you never know what the phone’s going to ring, and so I’ve got some more of the Japanese rock things to do and I’m doing a project with an opera singer who wants to do an orchestral album of songs. So it’s just — if the door’s open, interesting things come in. But I don’t really gauge my life on the writing projects. To me it’s what’s coming up. I’m getting to play the Norway jazz cruise with my trio, so that’s what’s exciting for me, and I’m going to be working on my next CD this summer and there’s three singers…
